ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 1:7 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-frequency distribution of small circular white-pixel clusters (10-40 pixel diameter) scattered across a contiguous dark-pigmented background on both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression visible at the lower convergence point with a pixel angle of approximately 45-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations of 5-20 pixels, most notably on the upper-right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical convexity; the right lobe follows a steep upward convex curve, while the left lobe follows a shallower, downward-slanted convex trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed white annular and circular pixel clusters distributed non-uniformly across the fluke surface, particularly concentrated on the distal regions of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several short, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (light grey on dark background) visible in the lower-central quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular indentation and jagged loss of material on the trailing edge of the right lobe distal to the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple overlapping concentric ring patterns across the entire visible surface, creating a distinctive mottled high-frequency texture.
